scene: The sour berry sparks your senses, revealing three buzzing rooftop transit docks.
picture: A flat side view along the level rooftop deck. On the far left, a yellow river hover ferry idles at an edge dock. Left of centre, the silver-haired boy stands blinking beside the stripped berry bush. At centre, a glass light-rail pod sits open. On the far right, a glowing green moving walkway ramp leads forward.
shown: a sleek yellow river hover ferry docked at the barrier on the far left
a spherical glass light-rail pod with open hatch waiting at the centre platform
a brightly glowing moving walkway ramp starting on the far right
